title: Escapewheel resource document
description: Shape of the document an adapter delivers alongside its rows to describe the resources it references rather than writes, per Part 03 §11.3. Each entry is a manifest resource entry as Part 04 §5 declares one, so this is a wrapper around the manifest's own schema rather than a second description of an entry: it checks the envelope and the two fields a build cannot fill for itself, and the manifest's schema checks the entry when the build writes it.

$schema.description: This document's meta-schema, by $id. Identity rather than a fetch instruction: a build MUST NOT dereference it and MUST NOT require it (Part 04 §5.4).

resources.description: One entry per resource this run references. A resource the adapter delivered rows for and wrote no bytes for belongs here; one the packet owns does not, its manifest entry being read off the array the adapter wrote.

resource_id.description: The resource this entry describes, dotted as every resource identifier is.

declaration_id.description: The checked logical declaration this resource instantiates.

uri.description: Where the resource is: an absolute URI, or a path under the source a `source` field names (Part 04 §5.5).

items.description: A manifest resource entry. Only `resource_id`, `declaration_id`, and `uri` are required. Every other field the manifest declares is permitted here and carried through.
